audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-4 were marked Skill in both layers while every one of whys[0..3], spikes[0] and early says Jayce owns that stage outright, and the Level 6 row was credited to Locke.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Locke, Skill]; the mirror audit (jayce__locke) states it has already been brought onto exactly that chart.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 set to Jayce at 4/10 and Level 6 to Skill at 5/10 in both layers, as one atomic group. First item stays Locke, 2+ items stays Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike says Jayce 'has no true ult' and calls his level 6 'a wet noodle', then whys[5] describes the first-item row as though it were level 6.
audit.why: The stance swap is on a 6s cooldown and the first attack after swapping to Mercury Cannon reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist — that shred is a real mid-trade spike, not nothing.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, mid and whys[4]/whys[5] rewritten: level 6 evens, first item is the window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Purgatory's grounding is named nowhere, and it is the interaction that makes the totem work here — Jayce's only outs are To the Skies! and the Hextech Capacitor move speed on a weapon swap, and grounding removes both.
audit.why: Locke R flags: grounding, slow, execute, 1000 range, 120/100/80s. Jayce P: 'When Jayce swaps weapons he gains Move Speed'; Hammer Q is a leap.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[1].text, mid, whys[5] and report[5].t, matching the mirror's finding from the other side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shock Blast is the tracked cooldown on every panel with no number given, so 'commit while it is down' has nothing behind it.
audit.why: Jayce Q is 16/14/12/10/8/6s — 16s at rank 1 is a huge window, 6s at max is barely one.

edits.before: Level 6 is even-to-yours: his ult is just a stance swap with no burst.
edits.after: Level 6 is even — his stance swap shreds resists on its first hit.

edits.before: Your R Purgatory execute plus item burst gives you the all-in kill at 6.
edits.after: First item is yours — Purgatory grounds him and the burst converts.

edits.before: You spike hard: Jayce has no true ult, so his level 6 is a wet noodle while your R Purgatory totem gives a real execute. If you can survive to 6 with a health lead, your all-in with E dash-through and R flips the lane.
edits.after: Level 6 evens it rather than flipping it: the swap is not burst, but Mercury Cannon's first hit shreds your armour and MR. Purgatory is the real edge — it grounds To the Skies! and the swap speed, so he cannot leave the zone.

edits.before: The lane inverts at 6. Jayce's ultimate is only a form-swap steroid, no burst spike, while your R Purgatory is a genuine execute totem. Hold your all-in for when his Cannon Q is down, E through him, and use his poke-inflicted missing HP to trigger P Silver Stake.
edits.after: The lane evens at 6 and turns on first item. The swap is not a burst spike, but Mercury Cannon's first attack shreds armour and MR. Purgatory grounds him — no To the Skies!, no swap speed — so hold it until Shock Blast (16s at rank 1) is down, then E through and finish.

edits.before: Kite back into Hammer E knockback when you dash in
edits.after: Knock you back with Thundering Blow as you dash in

edits.before: Track Jayce’s Shock Blast: Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 and gains range through the Gate — stand behind minions, close on the whiff, and Purgatory grounds his escape.

notes: Chart rows 1-4 said Skill while the prose under them said Jayce runs the lane; brought onto the packet chart in pairs, matching the mirror. The missing mechanic is Purgatory's grounding — Jayce's only outs are To the Skies! and the Hextech Capacitor swap speed, and both are shut off inside the zone, which is exactly why the totem converts here.
